# The Modern Trades Mentor

> Technology and AI guidance for owner-led contracting and service businesses in
> Pinellas County and the greater Tampa Bay area. Founded and run by Richard
> Fritzke, a 26-year HVAC and facilities operations professional — a tradesman
> who understands technology, not a technology consultant who discovered trades.

## What this business does

The Modern Trades Mentor LLC helps owner-led contracting firms — typically 5 to
30 employees, with a real office-to-field workflow — find and fix the operating
problems that waste time and make technology investments fail, then decide which
software and AI tools actually fit.

The core position: fix the underlying business problems *before* adopting
technology. The contractor keeps control of their business, their data, and
their decisions.

It is not a software development shop and does not resell software.

## Services

The offer ladder: diagnose, then fix, then maintain.

- **Contractor Operations Audit** (formerly Technology & AI Readiness Audit) —
  the entry engagement. Where the business is losing money and time before any
  tool is chosen. $1,500 founding price, five business days.
- **Outcome Sprints** — named, specific fixes for one diagnosed problem,
  scoped by the audit. Not a generic "implementation" engagement:
  - Unsold Estimate Recovery Sprint
  - Missed Call Recovery Sprint
  - Office Workflow Reduction Sprint
  - Maintenance Agreement Reactivation Sprint
  - CRM/FSM Utilization Sprint
- **Modern Operations Partnership** — ongoing advisory once a sprint has
  proven value, not sold as a cold retainer.
- **Software Selection & Stack Design**, **AI Adoption & Staff Training**,
  **Implementation Planning**, **Revenue Loss Recovery**, **Custom Workflow &
  Program Development** — supporting engagements, same vendor-neutral basis.

## Who it serves

HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, and general contracting firms, plus
non-trades service businesses with the same shape — med spa, dental, salon,
fitness, professional services.

## Service area

Home base: St. Petersburg, Florida.

**Pinellas County (core market):** St. Petersburg, Clearwater, Largo, Pinellas
Park, Dunedin, Palm Harbor, Tarpon Springs, Safety Harbor, Oldsmar, Seminole,
Gulfport, St. Pete Beach, Treasure Island, Madeira Beach, Indian Rocks Beach,
Belleair, South Pasadena, Kenneth City.

**Hillsborough County:** Tampa, Brandon, Riverview, Temple Terrace, Carrollwood,
Town 'n' Country, Lutz, Plant City, Apollo Beach, Ruskin, Valrico.

**Pasco County:** New Port Richey, Trinity, Wesley Chapel, Land O' Lakes.

## Founder credentials

Richard Fritzke — 26+ years in HVAC, facilities, and operations. 20+ technicians
supervised. 40+ facilities managed.

Licenses and credentials:
- ICC Master Mechanical License
- EPA Universal Certified
- Associate of Science, HVAC/R — Redstone College
- OSHA 30-Hour certified
- MSHA certified

Currently active in recommissioning and optimization work in commercial,
mission-critical, and complex facilities environments.

Earlier career: insurance underwriting with Burns & Wilcox, and previously held
licenses in property and casualty, life, and health insurance. Those licenses
are no longer active. The Modern Trades Mentor does not provide insurance,
legal, tax, or financial advice, and does not sell insurance products.

## How software vendor relationships work

The Modern Trades Mentor is vendor-neutral. It has no paid relationship with any
software vendor and takes no commission for recommending one. Recommendations
are based on fit for the specific business. If that ever changes, it will be
stated plainly on the site and disclosed to every client before a recommendation
is made.
